mockNotApplied: Mocked location not applied. Select Fake Traveler as the mock location app in Developer options.
howToInstructions: Long press where you want to be on the map and tap Apply. The location is mocked one or more times according to the settings below. While mocking, long press another point to move there. Tap Stop to end. Note: select Fake Traveler as the mock location app in Developer options.
mockCount: How many times to mock the location? (0 = infinite)
